transcription_check.scope: Faithful transcription of digital PDF, including visible defects; not archival verification.

notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l001: Speech continues from204; nested quotations supplied in English, with outer speech closing at205:25.
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l009: Өкүм бааша эрендин has awkward case linkage; English uses to the stern hero king as addressee of line10.
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l011: Кызыталак is harsh sexual invective; fucking preserves abusive register rather than literal etymology. Same for other occurrences.
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l013: Куурай retained as kuray stalks without asserting a botanical species.
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l014: Мыйзамдын гүлү is autumn aerial spider silk/gossamer, not law or a literal flower. Yudakhin quotes this exact paired verse: https://el-sozduk.kg/myyzam-6/
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l015: Visible алтай interpreted as алты ай, six months, in seasonal battle-duration context. Raw spelling not emended.
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l018: Сырттап rendered driving out; exact tactical sense (outflanking/forcing outward) uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l020: Сыйынган жерге rendered place of refuge; worshipped place is also linguistically possible, context favors refuge.
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l024: Сары изине чөп салуу idiom is relentless pursuit, not literal grass placement. 2015 phraseological dictionary: https://el-sozduk.kg/sary-izine-chop-saluu/
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l037: Сазаңшаң retained as Sazangshang, the named people beyond Beijing; no modern geographical identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l040: Атасы explicitly father; transition back to Döngö in next lines implicit, as in earlier Kochku description.
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l046: Unexpected капырга dative preserved in Kyrgyz; English follows contextual subject Döngö.
notes.manas-2010:p0205:b001:l048: Каканчылуу rendered seat of the Khakan; historical state/date not inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0206:b001:l002: Арбак rendered guardian spirit in praise formula; other ancestral-spirit nuance possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0206:b001:l011: Eighteen thousand worlds retained as cosmological epic expression, not converted to persons.
notes.manas-2010:p0206:b001:l015: Кол ыштык is a small single-hole apparatus/pit for smoking hides or leather vessels. Terminological reference at https://elib.manas.edu.kg/book/2849-0066192.pdf supports little hide-smoking pit, not gun smoke.
notes.manas-2010:p0206:b001:l029: Кылкүрөң retained as Kylküröng horse name; morphology/romanization provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0206:b001:l030: Өрттөнгүр rendered accursed one in narrator voice; literal curse is may he burn.
notes.manas-2010:p0206:b001:l041: Visible төөнү literally camel retained. Initial contextual giants reading rejected as unsupported emendation to дөөнү; indexed earlier Karalaevvolume also repeats төөнү. Referent unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0207:b001:l008: Жолум үй temporary/travel dwelling rendered traveler's small tent; precise structural size not inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0207:b001:l015: Капчалдай interpreted as ravine-like mouth, possibly a defective topographic term; requires review.
notes.manas-2010:p0207:b001:l017: Жең билектей associated with preceding fire stream, rendered arm-thick; implicit referent and exact sleeve/arm image uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0207:b001:l018: Кылып ийчү эмедей has no explicit object; terrible deed supplies contextual generic object without inventing a specific action.
notes.manas-2010:p0207:b001:l030: Аламан коюп rendered mass assault in battle context, not a horse race.
notes.manas-2010:p0207:b001:l034: Менде interpreted as пенде, mortal; visible raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0207:b001:l048: Көй кашка remains an uncertain heroic epithet. Fierce, marked warrior is provisional; precise markings/temperament nuance not established.
